# COBE2

1. Use the following command to dwonload the data

```bash
wget https://downloads.psl.noaa.gov/Datasets/COBE2/sst.mon.mean.nc
```

2. use `submit.sbatch` which runs `process_cobe2.py` to process the data. You may need to change path locations in `process_cobe2.py`

## Source
